prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in immediately after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path layouts, and custom pet style selector views.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility copy, desktop dock placement guidance banners, and desktop control action video cards.
No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence banners and flows, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, and archetype selector flows.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, split view story intros, and all tests showing no clear effect or negative performance.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Desktop Companion Welcome Redesign: Redesign the final home intro screen using a stage layout with a prominent companion mascot display and explicit tray-control guidance badges. (why: 35.2% of users drop off at the final step (finish conversion 64.8%), and support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Upload Style Inspection View: Add a new screen prior to photo uploading where users can inspect visual rendering style samples. (why: Adoption stage has a high mean duration (1017s) and 75.3% conversion, while users reported custom pet rendering output looking unexpected.)
2: [home, redesign] Full Bleed Interactive Waiting Stage: Transform the waiting room into a full bleed animated stage displaying progress animation with interactive sound samples. (why: The waiting step has a high mean completion time of 2336s; engaging full-bleed visual feedback reduces perceived drop-off during generation.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Quick Controls Action Badges: Add desktop interaction badges directly on the final welcome screen demonstrating mouse click actions and shortcuts. (why: Support logs indicate users are confused after setup on how to interact, speak to, or hide their pet on the desktop.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Comparison View: Switch choose_path screen layout to two_column with visual card components highlighting instant preset vs custom creation. (why: Conversion on choose_path is 83.5% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis.)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Sound & Visual Progress: Enable time estimates and add an active tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining background rendering behavior. (why: Home waiting stage has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, with support issues reporting stalling and launch confusion.)
6: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Companion Onboarding Teaser Screen: Insert a new introductory screen showing interactive companion desktop animations before path selection. (why: Mean time in choose_path step is 514s; demonstrating live desktop behavior early sets clear expectations.)

scores.note: Target step finish loses 35.2% of users and support confirms post-onboarding confusion, but previous finish redesigns failed (-5.0%).
Adoption has high drop-off and duration, but pre-adoption photo prep screens previously showed worse performance.
Home loses only 13.6% of users, lacks support email evidence, and full-bleed stage redesigns carry high execution risk.
Target step finish has highest drop-off and clear support tickets; adding badges is low friction compared to full redesigns.
Split-view path layouts consistently improved conversion (+3.3%) and address high decision duration on choose_path.
Interactive progress tip carousels are proven helpful and easy to configure, matching both long wait times and support tickets.
Adding an extra pre-selection screen adds friction, and similar introductory screens showed neutral to negative impact.
